title: Transport of arbitrary coherent scalar adjunct families
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, and any scheme X. Use the positive-level categories, specified quotient maps, exact realization S_n and restriction comparisons of [def-coef-finite-dualizing-data]. Let K_n be arbitrary ordinary etale derived objects, L_n arbitrary intrinsic objects, and e_n:S_n K_n ≅ L_n arbitrary isomorphisms. Let v_mn:T_mn K_m→K_n be invertible arrows satisfying the published scalar unit and quotient cocycle. Conjugate their ordinary scalar adjuncts through S_m, the specified realization restriction square, and e_m,e_n to obtain t_mn:L_m→Res_mn L_n. Then the intrinsic scalar transpose of each t_mn is invertible, t_nn followed by the normalized restriction unit is the identity, and the direct t_rn followed by the inverse normalized restriction compositor equals t_rm followed by Res_rm(t_mn). No exceptional objects, finite-type hypothesis or dualizing-map property is assumed.

proof.text: The uniquely section-normalized restriction comparisons respect identity and composition before localization. Exact derived localization preserves these squares. Conjugation through the intrinsic equivalence and the comparison-site scalar mate gives an invertible scalar-extension comparison, so transposition of the conjugated adjunct preserves invertibility.

Transpose the ordinary unit and cocycle through the scalar adjunctions; their triangle and composition equations give the corresponding restriction equations. Apply the coherent realization restriction squares, naturality at e_n and cancellation of adjacent e_n and its inverse. This proves the two displayed intrinsic semilinear equations.

theorem finiteDualizing_scalar_realization
    (K : ∀ n : ℕ, Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (finiteDualizingCoeff l E n) X)
    (L : ∀ n : ℕ, normalizedDVRDerived l E X n)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (finiteDualizingRealization l E X n).obj (K n) ≅ L n)
    (v : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      (Etale.scalarExtension (finiteDualizingQuotient l E h) X).obj (K m) ⟶ K n)
    (hv : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m), IsIso (v h))
    (hunit : ∀ n : ℕ, v (le_refl n) =
      (ProEtale.normalizedOriginScalarUnit X.smallEtaleTopology _
        (finiteDualizingQuotient_id l E n)).hom.app (K n))
    (hcomp : ∀ {r m n : ℕ} (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m),
      (Etale.scalarExtension (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hmn) X).map (v hrm) ≫ v hmn =
      (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp X.smallEtaleTopology _ _ _
        (finiteDualizingQuotient_comp l E hrm hmn)).hom.app (K r) ≫ v (hmn.trans hrm)) :
    let t := fun {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) ↦
      (e m).inv ≫ (finiteDualizingRealization l E X m).map
        ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology
          (finiteDualizingQuotient l E h))).homEquiv _ _ (v h)) ≫
      (finiteDualizingRealizationRestriction l E X h).inv.app (K n) ≫
      (normalizedDVRRes l E X h).map (e n).hom
    (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      IsIso (((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (normalizedDVRRes l E X h)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (t h))) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, t (le_refl n) ≫ (normalizedDVRResUnit l E X n).hom.app (L n) = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ {r m n : ℕ} (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m),
      t (hmn.trans hrm) ≫ (normalizedDVRResComp l E X hrm hmn).inv.app (L n) =
        t hrm ≫ (normalizedDVRRes l E X hrm).map (t hmn))
